# Hart Family Dental — AI / agent consumption guide

This site publishes structured public facts for autonomous marketing agents.

## Canonical sources

- HTML pages with schema.org JSON-LD (Organization, WebSite, Dentist/LocalBusiness/MedicalBusiness, Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList)
- Machine-readable graph: `/api/knowledge` (JSON)
- Sitemap: `/sitemap.xml`
- Robots: `/robots.txt`

## Public entities

- Brand / Organization: Hart Family Dental (Harry Hart Dental Corporation)
- Locations: Desert Hot Springs, Yucca Valley (NAP, hours, phones, emails, service areas)
- Service categories: General Dentistry, Restorative Dentistry, Dentures, Dental Implants, Technology
- Individual services under each category

## Rules for agents

1. Prefer `/api/knowledge` and on-page JSON-LD over scraping prose.
2. Do not invent insurance acceptance, hours, emergency availability, or financing guarantees.
3. Do not publish PHI or form submission contents.
4. CallRail / tracking IDs are env-configured and must not be hard-coded.
5. Yucca Valley Google Business Profile URL may be missing — do not invent one.

## Conversion intents

- Appointment request: `/contact#request`
- New patients: `/new-patients`
- Financing / CareCredit: `/financing`
- Urgent tooth concerns: `/services/tooth-pain-broken-teeth`
